issues.on_page: Golf Fund operating expenses by cost type (Personnel costs 106,170, Utilities and telephone 25,988, Repairs and maintenance 35,724 ... Depreciation 25,000)
issues.issue: Golf Fund (business-type) cost-type lines keep the function culture/recreation while the Electric/Water/Sewer/Trash lines in the same statement take the cost type as category (Salaries and Wages, Repairs and Maintenance...). The cost-type rule is written for utility spending, so this is defensible, but the same printed labels get different categories within the report.

issues.on_page: Public works 339,658 (Street Fund 282,514 + General Fund 57,144; p16 shows the GF 57,144 is the Cemetery department)
issues.issue: Mixed line: about 17% is cemetery spending, which the detail lines categorise as health/welfare (pp15-16). The statement line stays streets/highways (dominant), so detail and statement categories differ for the cemetery money. Already flagged with review.

issues.on_page: Department columns: transfers in total 77,686, out (129,846), net (52,160); fund statement p5 shows GF transfers in 5,190, out (57,350)
issues.issue: Recorded as printed. The departmental schedule includes 72,496 of transfers between General Fund departments that the fund-level statement nets out, so detail transfers in/out are each 72,496 larger than the fund statement's (net agrees at -52,160).

issues.on_page: Franchise fees 60,000 (business-type general revenues); utility funds pay Franchise fees 196,000 (p9 Total)
issues.issue: The franchise fees received by the Golf Fund (60,000) and most of the governmental 156,420 appear to be paid by the city's own Electric/Water/Sewer/Trash funds (196,000 of operating expense), so the same money is both utility spending and receipts. Kept as printed (correct under the as-printed rule); flagged for awareness only.
